title: Eval scenario body
description: An eval scenario as a record (register row DK1221, from DK800; spec-delta S1650): the log carries only the HASHES of what the scenario asks (`task_sha256`) and how a run is checked (`check_sha256`), the skill it tests and a difficulty from 1 to 5, never the text. Signed by an identity the log knows (eval_scenario_unknown_author). A `held_out` scenario is the Registrar's: only the Registrar signs one (eval_held_out_not_registrar), and `evalScenarios` does not list held-out scenarios to anyone else, so an author never sees the set its agent is graded on. One scenario for each skill and task hash (eval_scenario_known). Chain: none (prev is null).
